summary_1line: Baladeva urges conciliatory diplomacy with Duryodhana, but Satyaki fiercely rejects appeasement and calls for war to restore Yudhishthira’s kingdom.

image_candidates.scene_text: Satyaki suddenly rises in the assembly, angrily denouncing Baladeva while warriors listen in tense silence.
Satyaki boasts of the Pandava champions—Arjuna with his bow, Bhima towering, and Krishna with the discus—ready to crush the Kauravas.
